cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — perched on a ledge or edge; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — holds a cup in both hands; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a second-hand book stall under an awning on a quiet street — standing close to a high shelf or line
